text:
alex: seeing a spike of apiserver 503s in eu-west1 during a node onboarding burst. controller-manager logs show probe backoff and a retry storm, provisioner seems to be retrying attaches aggressively.
rachel: ugh. can you paste a short log snippet and which pools are hitting it?
alex: log: ```apiserver.go:124] GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods: net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded)
controller-manager: E0312 14:12:01 controller.go:98] Failed to sync attach: rate limit exceeded, backoff 1.2s
provisioner: attach call failed: 503 Service Unavailable```
leo: this smells like NAT SNAT port exhaustion + keepalive/conn reuse issues. saw similar last quarter where many short-lived connections killed conntrack buckets.
sre-bot: :rotating_light: Incident created INC-2026 (apiserver-503s-eu-west1)
jin: quick mitigations: 1) throttle provisioner RPS client-side, 2) tune controller-manager QPS/Burst flags, 3) bump conntrack table and tcp_tw_recycle off. can try 1+2 immediately.
rachel: i'll prepare a rolling patch for controller-manager flags (QPS/Burst) — safer than sysctl in-prod without approval. also we can add short-term egress spread (route some onboarding to eu-central) if churn keeps up.
alex: applying quick throttle on provisioner: reduced from 60rps -> 10rps and enabled exponential backoff in client. patch: ```kubectl -n infra patch deployment provisioner --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/--max-rps","value":"10"}]'```
leo: nice. also check NAT metrics (cloud-nat) for port occupancy and ephemeral port exhaustion. if >80% we're in trouble.
jin: small helper: controller-manager patch (example) ```kubectl -n kube-system patch deployment controller-manager --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"kube-controller-manager","args":["--kube-api-qps=5","--kube-api-burst=10"]}]}}}}'```
rachel: rolling that now. watching apiserver latency + errors.
alex: after throttle + controller-manager patch, 503s dropped within 30s. attaching short metrics: apiserver 5xx rate down from 48/s -> 2/s, conntrack ports used down ~40%.
leo: great. next steps: (a) add client-side token bucket limiter in provisioner (b) add circuit breaker to fail fast when API error rate > threshold (c) dashboard for conntrack / nat port usage and per-region egress saturation.
rachel: +1. i'll open follow-ups and tag infra/cost for NAT capacity planning — note reserved NAT or dedicated egress will cost more but reduces these blasts.
alex: opened TICKET-4532 for provisioner rate limiter & CB, TICKET-4533 for dashboard, and cost request in procurement.
sre-bot: Incident INC-2026 marked resolved by alex.
rachel: :thumbsup:
